items.pain: A trusted local consumer can repeatedly stop before queue admission when its accepted entry/checklist digests drift from the pinned execution specification.
items.customer: Operators of scheduled coding-agent evaluation and replay pipelines.
items.current_workaround: Manual scheduler diagnosis, trusted-digest comparison, configuration backup, and in-place prompt recovery.
items.AEG_advantage: Immutable policy/entry/checklist digests plus append-only receipts make false authorization stops diagnosable without weakening the trust boundary.
items.evidence: Ten attributable scheduled failures stopped at POLICY; manual recovery passed fixed-file and current-authorization checks but has not yet produced a scheduled CLAIM.
items.next_experiment: Observe the next scheduled post-recovery invocation and require either one valid #3076 CLAIM or a new precise admission failure receipt.
items.strongest_counterevidence: This may be an AEG-specific configuration defect rather than a recurring buyer problem; no external operator, repeat user or payment signal exists.

items.pain: Shopping agents can attach stale prices or policies to the wrong variant, seller, channel or locality and may invent unresolved availability.
items.customer: Consumers and teams building commerce assistants.
items.current_workaround: Re-open retailer pages, manually cross-check variant/seller/policy scope, and abstain when dynamic fields are unresolved.
items.AEG_advantage: A provenance-bound decision procedure can label stable versus revalidate-at-query facts and preserve variant, seller, channel and observation time.
items.evidence: Three public read-only tasks across Best Buy, IKEA and Walmart exposed variant, channel and dynamic-availability risks; three objective paired designs exist but none ran.
items.next_experiment: PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED: one frozen P1 or P2 control/treatment pair with factual-error and unsupported-inference counts.
items.strongest_counterevidence: No paired outcome, repeatability, user behavior, operational adoption or willingness-to-pay signal exists.

items.pain: Conformance checks can report green while exercising an unknown-tool error instead of the intended elicitation or logging behavior.
items.customer: MCP SDK maintainers and coding-agent evaluation teams relying on conformance results.
items.current_workaround: Manual fixture inspection and upstream regression repair.
items.AEG_advantage: Preserve the vacuous-green failure map and bind replay to non-vacuity assertions, not only a green suite.
items.evidence: Merged python-sdk PR #3442 provides frozen pre/post commits and a deterministic 75-minute historical replay design.
items.next_experiment: After #3076 completes and existing ordering permits, replay only the fixture mechanism and archive red/green plus non-vacuity evidence.
items.strongest_counterevidence: The repair is already public and merged; recurrence, independent reuse and buyer value are UNKNOWN.

items.pain: Windows executable resolution can block the event loop and delay cancellation before a subprocess is created.
items.customer: MCP Python users and maintainers running stdio clients on Windows.
items.current_workaround: Merged thread-offload repair plus deterministic cancellation regression test.
items.AEG_advantage: A frozen replay can preserve the platform-specific failure signature, isolation boundary and cancellation oracle for environment drift.
items.evidence: Merged python-sdk PR #3510 provides frozen pre/post commits and a scoped 60-minute historical replay design.
items.next_experiment: After higher-priority READY/backlog work, prove the simulated Windows oracle discriminates on the consumer host before replay.
items.strongest_counterevidence: Only one public repair is observed; recurrence, cross-environment reuse and buyer value are UNKNOWN.
